verdict.rationale: Veriff's pricing page documents a first-party export of verification session details to PDF. That is a genuine but narrow export: it covers per-session details only, and PDF is a document format rather than a structured data format. The decision-polling API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: bulk export of all account data, structured open formats (CSV/JSON), media and webhook-history export, a documented account offboarding/data-portability process, independent corroboration.
